messages.content:
You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

REJECT if:
- Requires the worker to live in US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- Is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- Requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (midnight to 6am Taipei time)

KEEP if any of these is true:
- Says worldwide remote, work from anywhere, global remote
- Says APAC remote or Asia-friendly
- Allows international contractors
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement
- No geographic restriction mentioned

Return JSON only — no extra text:
{"taiwan_eligible":"yes/no/unclear","reason":"short reason","location_risk":"low/medium/high","timezone_risk":"low/medium/high","contractor_possible":"yes/no/unclear","decision":"keep/reject/manual_check"}

You are a cover letter writer for Jerry, a bilingual (English/Mandarin) professional based in Taiwan.

Jerry's background:
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background (SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads)
- Data science bootcamp — Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience: dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics
- Wants async global remote work

Write a cover letter specific to the job provided. Mention how Jerry can:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Rules:
- Under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- NO generic phrases like "I am writing to apply"
- Reference the specific company and role
- End with a clear call to action

Return ONLY the cover letter text, no subject line or JSON wrapper.

_meta.description: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter — built for Jerry. Searches 8 job boards, filters for Taiwan eligibility and async culture, scores each job 0-100, writes to Google Sheets, sends Gmail digest daily and Telegram alerts for scores 85+.
setup_checklist: 1. Create a Google Sheet named 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 sheets: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected
2. Add columns to Raw Jobs: date_found, source, job_title, company, job_url, location_text, salary, description, posted_date, tags, job_id

3. Add columns to Filtered Jobs: date_found, score, job_title, company, job_url, salary, taiwan_eligible, taiwan_reason, location_risk, timezone_risk, contractor_possible, async_level, role_category, why_good_fit, decision, application_status, notes
4. Add columns to Rejected: date_rejected, job_title, company, job_url, reason
5. Add columns to Applied: date_applied, job_title, company, job_url, cover_letter_used, status, follow_up_date, notes
6. In n8n, add credentials: Google Sheets (OAuth2), OpenAI API, Gmail (OAuth2), Telegram Bot
7. Replace PASTE_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE in all Google Sheets nodes with your actual Sheet ID (from the URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_ID_HERE)
8. Replace CONFIGURE_YOUR_*_CREDENTIAL_ID in all nodes with your actual n8n credential IDs
9. For Telegram: create a bot via @BotFather, get the token, and set YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID to your chat ID
10. Activate the workflow — it will run daily at 8:30 AM Asia/Taipei

scoring_breakdown.threshold: Keep if score >= 70 | Alert if score >= 85
